messages:
deploybot: Deploy paused: emergency hold triggered for release 2024-03-12T18:45Z. Reason: auth-service in eu-west-1 crossing 1m 5xx SLA threshold (circuit-breaker engaged). Auto-pin active. Notifying oncall and release leads. :warning:

maria: seeing this in Dashboard too, 5xx spike aligns with a config rollout about 18:40Z. Do we have a short blamestack?

kevin: suggest we avoid an immediate rollback until we confirm scope. If it's a dependent config, rollback might not help. Can we pin the current runnable version and re-run canary after fix?

sanjay: oncall here. I already escalated to infra. Initial checks: kube pods for auth-service in eu-west-1 are OOM restarting intermittently. Suspect memory regression in new sidecar.

maria: ok — action 1: pin release to previous version to stop new traffic landing on nodes. action 2: ops to patch sidecar or scale if needed. action 3: communicate ETA to stakeholders.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1843 — auth-service high 5xx rate in eu-west-1. Pager duty: sanjay. Links: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2024-1843

kevin: pin done (release pinned to v2024.03.11-9a7f). Deploybot confirms no new rollouts will proceed on that slot.

deploybot: Confirmed: version pinned for release slot. Canary and staged rollouts stopped. Fallback policy set to stable variant.

maria: please add a short note to release notes / internal change log: "Hold placed 03/12 18:45Z due to auth-service errors in eu-west-1; pinned to previous stable; investigating" — I'll draft the public comms if needed.

sanjay: infra ran a quick heap dump and identified a memory leak in sidecar 2.1.4. Rolling a hotfix to sidecar 2.1.5 on a single canary node first.

kevin: runbook step: after hotfix canary passes for 15m with no 5xx, we can re-run canary for the app release. If canary fails, plan B is to revert sidecar to 2.1.3 across the fleet.

maria: timeline? ops, estimate time to fix + canary pass?

sanjay: aiming for 30m to push hotfix and 15m canary window => re-eval @ 19:30Z. I'll post status updates.

kevin: also updating the release tracker and toggling the slot to "blocked: incident" so releasebot doesn't auto-resume.

deploybot: Release slot flagged as blocked by incident INC-2024-1843. Auto-resume disabled until manual clear.

maria: noted. I'll notify PM and support about the hold and give them the INC link + pinned version. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder set: check-in at 1718255400 (approx 19:30Z) for status update.

kevin: after we clear, we should schedule a staggered requeue: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> full over 45m with additional monitoring hooks. Add note to release notes about the rollback/pin and the sidecar hotfix.

sanjay: hotfix deployed to canary at 18:58Z, initial metrics look stable (0 new 5xx in last 5m). Continuing observation.

maria: great. keeping the slot blocked until we confirm 15m steady state. Then we'll decide requeue window.

kevin: sounds good. I'll prep the staggered deploy plan and customer-facing blurb in case we need to inform larger customers.

maria: final checklist when clearing: 1) incident link + summary 2) pinned version removed 3) staggered rollout plan 4) release notes updated 5) postmortem owner assigned. Assigning to kevin for postmortem.

kevin: assigned. I'll draft the postmortem and timeline once we clear.

sanjay: will update status in INC-2024-1843 and call for unblocking after 15m stable.

maria: thanks team. Waiting for oncall un-block. :white_check_mark:
